meta_title: Not a TouchBistro Alternative: Keep It, Add Voice Ordering
meta_desc: If the POS is the problem, you need another one. If it's the supply order, speak it to a distributor that offers our app. No TouchBistro alternative needed.

problem.h2: Why people look for a TouchBistro competitor
problem.lead: An alternative to TouchBistro means swapping the POS and retraining every server on it. Sometimes the reason is service. Sometimes it is how you order from your distributor, and that part can change on its own.

cards.h3: If it's the register or the floor
cards.body: If the reason is payments, the floor plan or the menu screens, the TouchBistro alternative you need is another POS. VoiceOrder Solutions is not one.

TouchBistro sells supply ordering in two add-ons, Inventory Management and Profit Management, quoted apart from the POS. If you run neither, and no partner tool, your distributor gets the order as it does today: by phone, by message or through the rep.

Inventory Management turns the suggestion for each vendor into a PO (purchase order). It emails the PO, or sends it online to select vendors. Both paths have you build the order on a screen. Neither, on their site, has you say it aloud.

cards.h2: Which orders move to our app, and which stay with TouchBistro
cards.lead: This is not a TouchBistro replacement. TouchBistro runs the dining room, and add-ons such as Inventory Management handle counts and costs. Orders move over only for distributors on VoiceOrder Solutions: spoken from the walk-in, then reviewed before they leave.

items.h3: TouchBistro gets no copy of the order
items.body: Nothing you send from our app turns into a PO in TouchBistro's Inventory Management. If you track those items there, record the delivery there yourself, as you would for any order made outside it.
A partner inventory app linked to TouchBistro keeps its link. Count in it as you do now. Where a distributor uses our app, read out the items you need and check the lines.

items.h3: Leave online vendors where they are
items.body: If a vendor already takes your orders online through TouchBistro, leave that vendor there. Our app is for a distributor you still reach by phone or through the rep.

midcta.h3: Follow one sample order from the walk-in to a distributor
midcta.body: Our 20-minute demo speaks a short list into the app, changes one item, and shows what lands at the distributor's end.

items.q: Do I need a TouchBistro alternative to speak a supply order?
items.a: No. All it takes is a distributor with our app. Then you talk that order into the app, so there is no call to make.

items.q: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than TouchBistro?
items.a: The two are built for separate jobs. Payments, tables, tableside orders, guest online orders, staff and stock counts: we do none of these, and we are not a POS. Ours is the order to a distributor on our app, spoken aloud and checked one item at a time. In TouchBistro's add-ons, you put each order together on screen; if you prefer to say it, that takes no TouchBistro alternative.

items.q: Do VoiceOrder Solutions and TouchBistro connect?
items.a: No. They are separate companies, each with its own help desk, and they share no data. Whatever you say in our app is sent to your distributor alone; neither TouchBistro nor a tool linked to it gets a copy.

items.q: If my reason for leaving is the POS itself, will this help?
items.a: Not with that part. Payments, tables or menu screens need a different POS, and we do not make one. If you move to another POS later, ordering in our app carries on as before, because it was never connected to TouchBistro.

items.q: I already order through TouchBistro Inventory Management. How does this fit?
items.a: Stay with it for the vendors you order from online or by email. Where a distributor has our app, you can speak that order instead. Send each distributor's order from one place only, so nothing is ordered twice.

items.q: What happens if I say "six" and the screen shows sixteen?
items.a: You catch it on the review screen before sending: change the amount, swap the item, or delete the line. That review is the safeguard, so a hurried glance can still let a mistake through. A phoned-in or voicemail order gets no number from us; only orders placed in the app carry one.

items.q: How do I get set up, and what does it cost?
items.a: Through your distributor: they open your account, and most kitchens place a first order the same day. If yours does not have it, order from them as you do today, and get in touch: we will work out who you should talk to. For cost, ask the distributor you would get the app from; we publish no price. TouchBistro lists prices for its POS plans and gives quotes for its back-office tools.

items.q: Where do the TouchBistro details on this page come from?
items.a: From touchbistro.com as we read it on 9 November 2026: its POS page, the pages for both back-office add-ons, plus pricing and integrations. On that date we saw nothing there about ordering supplies by speaking. Inventory Management is offered in the continental US and in Canada outside Quebec. We left out TouchBistro's own customer counts and savings claims. If any of it has gone out of date, send us a note and we will put it right.

mainCta.h2: Ordering supplies was the reason? Keep TouchBistro and speak your next order to the distributor.
mainCta.body: Ask your distributor whether they offer VoiceOrder Solutions. If they are hard to reach, ask us and we will check.
